english.title: Leave cargo / baggage / park vehicle / equipment in unauthorised place at Stansted Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[left cargo, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CARGO..),]_
(B)_[left baggage, namely **(..SPECIFY THE BAGGAGE..),]_
(C)_[parked a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(D)_[parked equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE EQUIPMENT..),]_

at Stansted Airport elsewhere than in a place provided by the Airport Company for the purpose, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION WHERE THE CARGO / BAGGAGE / VEHICLE / EQUIPMENT LEFT / PARKED..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 6(3) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: This Byelaw applies to any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply unless the permission of the Airport Company has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or excuse.
